title: October 31–November 1 — seven missing branches reviewed
summary: Seven source-reviewed repositories, separated from already indexed SweepAtlas and TransformerX. Evidence includes a failed Comb gate, failed 2729 held-out order, Model6 error-vs-edge tradeoff, classical phase-copy tie and a Model7 preregistration without test results. Source results are not independently replicated.

nodes.claim: An executable browser XOR lab: 16-dimensional rotating state → trained four-class workspace readout → learned copy/invert comb selection.
nodes.killed: Intact Brier 0.29062 loses to cut-read 0.24998; analytical Bayesian filter achieves 81.93% accuracy against 55.86% learned. Not actual Jacobian J-space or superior memory.
nodes.era: October 31: practical video, loop control and writable cavity

nodes.claim: Windows EXE/Python stitching system combining a 2-D observed-pixel video atlas with frequency-tuned Sigh/moiré edge matching.
nodes.survived: Working GUI, frequency controls, crop, PNG export, Windows release/Actions and synthetic self-test.
nodes.killed: The M key toggles moiré visualization, not frequency processing; 2× output grid is not 2× recovered VHS detail; parallax is uncorrected.
nodes.era: October 31: practical video, loop control and writable cavity

nodes.claim: Combines the WallMemoryLaw propagating cavity and ChainNeuronsWithPhaseSpike private phase-pair writers via a declared D→Robin-wall-spring transducer.
nodes.survived: Parent physics checks pass; 30 reads cause no pair slips. Selected analog spring echoes correlate r=.95 and spring spatial arrangement affects received drive.
nodes.killed: The A→B/B→A held-out gap/noise task fails and patterned springs never beat pooled springs. Neumann control has undamped zero-mode confound; matched clocks and unforced/reference twins are idealized.
nodes.era: October 31: practical video, loop control and writable cavity

nodes.claim: Convolutional sparse coding coordinates overlapping local atoms to invert Sihti or true heat fog, with Wiener, patch, no-inhibition and EPLL controls.
nodes.survived: Sihti-fog 400-step CSC MSE 0.00183 vs Wiener .00247, independent .00223 and EPLL .00200; purify^8 at dt=.25 is recognized as band-stop rather than uniform low-pass.
nodes.killed: Edge-F against no-inhibition fails (.786 vs .810), as does temporal flicker against independent (.0145 vs .0085); converged CSC loses to EPLL. Limited 32×32 crops.

nodes.claim: Earlier noise probe controls Fourier branch gains for phase-aligned matching; Stage 2 transports image memory through phase and resets on scene change.
nodes.survived: On synthetic sequences raw MSE .3819, reset phase-copy .0816, stale phase-copy .5123.
nodes.killed: Classical aligned running average with identical reset ties at .0816; classical inverse-noise weights beat learned branch routing. No biophysical dendrite or real-camera task.

nodes.claim: Exact 17-complex-map directional frame plus learned frozen patch dictionary; second experiment uses wavevector-specific phase shifts for translation.
nodes.survived: 18 held-out synthetic shapes: phase motion mean error .100 px vs phase correlation .205 px; scrambled wavevectors worsen error.
nodes.killed: Phase vocabulary loses denoising to Gaussian/Wiener and phase-free matched atoms. On unrelated patterns .088 px loses to phase correlation .041 px; no temporal learned world.

nodes.claim: Preregistered Model 6 CSC extension with complex phase-congruency/energy silence gates, wrong-world dictionaries and precision/trust temporal paper.
nodes.survived: Contains source scripts, test definitions, a preregistration and pretest amendment; inherits frozen Model 6 CSC settings.
nodes.killed: At this review, no committed held-out test results ledger or root README; validation pilots are not test successes.

motifs.title: A cavity can carry writable local state without robust event-order inference
motifs.description: 2729 combines wave reading with locally retained pair-state writing. The held-out order and pooled-spring controls fail despite physical sensitivity.

motifs.title: A real state-to-operator pathway is not automatically a useful advantage
motifs.description: Redux's recurrent state causally selects its comb but its benchmark loses to cut-read and Bayes; TransformerX previously found simpler read routers could match an interaction-heavy one.

motifs.title: Phase and multi-scale restoration require uncertainty and matched ordinary controls
motifs.description: VHS observed pixels, Sihti sparse atoms, Model7 preregistered gating, Cortex phase-memory and Janus phase geometry have different tasks and limits, not one general visual world model.
